name: The Gang

rounds.endCondition: Game ends when the team has 3 successful heists or 3 failed heists (3 to 5 heists)

categories.label: Heist results (tick = success, cross = failure)
categories.labelVi: Kết quả từng phi vụ (✓ thành công, ✗ thất bại)
categories.hint: A heist succeeds when the chip order matches the hand ranking order at showdown; any mistake trips an alarm

winCondition: Each game has 3 to 5 heists of 4 rounds each. A heist succeeds if the final (red) chips are in the correct order of hand strength at the showdown; the team wins on 3 successful heists and loses on 3 failures. Advanced/Professional/Master Thief modes add challenge and specialist cards (not modelled).
notes: family: coop. No points. Difficulty rises with player count. Advanced/Professional modes add an extra showdown requirement (guessing hand rank).

sources.title: The Gang Review: High-Stakes Cooperative Poker

winConditionVi: Mỗi ván có 3-5 phi vụ. Cả đội thắng khi đạt 3 phi vụ thành công, thua khi dính 3 phi vụ thất bại. Chỉ cần ghi kết quả từng phi vụ.
uiHintReason: Heist strip: tap success/failure per heist, auto-stop at 3 wins or 3 losses.
